description: Shunned by her family over false accusations against her mother, Ayali tolerates her stepmom’s cruelty and teams up with Siva to expose Varma and prove her mother's innocence.
A show where women dancers portray their talent, strength and passion as they team up with the male celebrities and give wings to their dreams to win the title.
In the village council, Karthikeyan exposes Sivanandi and Muthuvel for stealing temple ornaments.
Sreeja tricks Subhadra and brings Ashok to the ware house and falls into the trap laid by Vishal.
Posing as goddess, Janaki scares Padma and urges her to perform a ritual for Seenu and Maya.
Sumathi raises her daughters, Thenmozhi and Meenakshi, with values. Thenmozhi marries into Mano’s debt-ridden family. But, to protect Thenmozhi and restore the family’s dignity, Meenakshi weds Jeeva.
Veera and Kanmani lose their brother in a road accident caused by Maaran. What happens when a series of unfortunate events lead Veera to marry Maaran, and Kanmani decides to seek revenge?
